commands.command:
set -eu
sudo install -d -o syslog -g adm -m 0755 /var/log/inventory
sudo tee /etc/rsyslog.d/10-inventory-receiver.conf >/dev/null <<'ANTRIEB_RSYSLOG_EOF'
# Receive only inventory messages from node2 over reliable TCP.
module(load="imtcp")

template(name="InventoryNode2Format" type="string"
         string="%timegenerated:::date-rfc3339% %hostname% %syslogtag%%msg%\n")

ruleset(name="inventory_from_node2") {
    if ($fromhost-ip == "10.100.124.11" and $programname == "inventory") then {
        action(type="omfile"
               file="/var/log/inventory/node2.log"
               template="InventoryNode2Format"
               flushOnTXEnd="on")
    }
    stop
}

input(type="imtcp" port="514" ruleset="inventory_from_node2")
ANTRIEB_RSYSLOG_EOF
sudo chmod 0644 /etc/rsyslog.d/10-inventory-receiver.conf
sudo rsyslogd -N1

commands.command:
set -eu
sudo tee /etc/rsyslog.d/10-inventory-forwarder.conf >/dev/null <<'ANTRIEB_RSYSLOG_EOF'
# Reliably forward inventory application messages to node1.
if ($programname == "inventory") then {
    action(type="omfwd"
           target="10.100.124.10"
           port="514"
           protocol="tcp"
           action.resumeRetryCount="-1"
           queue.type="linkedList"
           queue.filename="inventory_fwd"
           queue.saveOnShutdown="on")
}
ANTRIEB_RSYSLOG_EOF
sudo chmod 0644 /etc/rsyslog.d/10-inventory-forwarder.conf
sudo rsyslogd -N1 -f /etc/rsyslog.d/10-inventory-forwarder.conf
sudo systemctl restart rsyslog
sleep 1
systemctl is-active rsyslog
systemctl is-enabled rsyslog
ss -ntp | grep '10.100.124.10:514' || true
sudo journalctl -u rsyslog -n 20 --no-pager
